m: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces, season with salt and pepper and toss in the cornflour so it's lightly coated.
Glaze: honey, soy, rice vinegar, grated garlic and ginger, plus 2 tbsp water per serve.
Fry the chicken in a hot pan with a good splash of oil, in batches, 6 to 7 minutes until golden and crisp on the edges.
Meanwhile cut the broccoli into small florets and char in a separate hot pan with a little oil for 4 minutes, then add a splash of water and cover for 2 minutes.
Pour the glaze over the chicken and bubble 2 minutes, tossing, until thick and sticky.
Serve over rice with the broccoli, spring onion and sesame seeds.
l: Chicken, broccoli and rice in one container. The glaze keeps it juicy when reheated.
g: Tamari instead of soy, and make sure the cornflour is 100% maize. Cook the GF batch first in a clean pan.
